§32.5 Integral Equations

ⓘ
Keywords:
Painlevé transcendents, applications, integral equations
Notes:
See Ablowitz and Segur (1977, 1981); also Ablowitz and Clarkson (1991).
Permalink:

See also:

Let K⁡(z,ζ) be the solution of

32.5.1 K⁡(z,ζ)=k⁢Ai⁡(z+ζ2)+k24⁢∫z∞∫z∞K⁡(z,s)⁢Ai⁡(s+t2)⁢Ai⁡(t+ζ2)⁢ds⁢dt,
ⓘ
Symbols:
Ai⁡(z): Airy function, dx: differential of x, ∫: integral, z: real, k: real and K⁡(z,ζ): solution

32.5.2 w⁡(z)=K⁡(z,z),

z→+∞.
